# Approval Differential Reduced Corpus (`approval_diff_reduced.jsonl`)

Deterministic subset of the full omp `v19.1.1` (`31ffee513f`) approval differential corpus generated by `piglets/oh-my-pig/proof/diff/approval/` (`make-corpus.sh` → `oracle.ts`, running omp's real `tools/approval.ts`, `tools/index.ts`, `tools/resolve.ts`, `mcp/tool-bridge.ts`, `task/executor.ts`, and `config/settings.ts`, then reduced by `select-reduced.py`; see `piglets/oh-my-pig/proof/diff/approval/README.md` for commands).

- **Source corpus**: `$DIFF_OUT/corpus.jsonl` (produced by `piglets/oh-my-pig/proof/diff/approval/make-corpus.sh`)
- **Source corpus sha256**: `b64b61eb9a439973cea276bef7142d7953234de7fc6daddf5c849d13c978d494` (`b64b61eb9a439973`)
- **Reduced corpus sha256**: `00bb1a189d9c960ccc13afa26642789d30f62f988c075940368fcbd18903059c` (`00bb1a189d9c960c`)
- **Size**: 1,986,039 bytes (1.89 MiB / 1.99 MB), 3,873 cases across 443 settings groups, covering all 10 sections and all 29 compared tools.

## Deterministic Selection Rule (original corpus ID order)

1. **Focused sections kept at 100% (all compared cases)**:
   - `paths` (624), `unwrap` (693), `cached` (34), `interceptor` (300), `project` (360 — includes all 47 `port-stricter` and all 80 `port-ignores-untrusted-project`), `glob-path` (120), `nil-setting` (48), `malformed` (48 — all 48 `fail-closed`).
2. **`base` (1,338 compared cases)**:
   - All distinct `(tool, args)` variants for no-policy `interactive`/`top` under `always-ask` and `always-ask-cached`.
   - First case per `(mode, tool, tier, decision, source)` for no-policy `interactive`/`top` under `<unset>`, `yolo`, and `write`.
   - First case per `(mode, ui, session, tier, decision, source)` across all 5 modes for `headless`/`top`, `headless`/`subagent`, and `interactive`/`subagent`.
   - First case per `(mode, userPolicy, ui, session, tier, decision, source)` across all 5 modes × `(allow, deny, prompt)` × `(interactive/top, headless/top, headless/subagent)`, plus at least one case per tool for `(always-ask, deny)`, `(always-ask, allow)`, and `(yolo, prompt)` on `interactive`/`top`.
   - All `bash.patterns` commands for no-policy `interactive`/`top` under `<unset>` and `always-ask`, plus first case per `(mode, userPolicy, ui, session, decision, source, reason)`.
3. **`restricted` (308 compared cases)**:
   - All 39 tool calls for all 3 `tools.restrictedFolders` configurations (`["secrets"]`, `["."]`, `["./secrets/", "other-dir"]`) under `<unset>` mode + no user policy on `interactive`/`top` (117 cases).
   - First case per `(restrictedFolders, mode, userPolicy, ui, session, decision, source)` across all modes, user policies (`allow`, `deny`, `prompt`), UI modes, and top/subagent sessions.
4. **Unwrap-route end-to-end test (`TestOmpApprovalUnwrapRoute`)**:
   - Exercises all 17 bracketed `proc://<job>/kill` shapes end-to-end against `write` under `tools.approvalMode: write` with all prompts dismissed, asserting 0 violations.
